name: weld_symbol_on_the_joint
why: ENTRY GT7. The T of the weld cases (an 80x80x5 bar 600 long, one of 300 arriving on top of it, cut on the first) put on the drawing with the ISO fillet weld symbol, throat 4. Measured with the little test rig on 26/9/2026: the code of the symbol is the one of the library gtol.sym, «<WELD-FILL>»; with «<IGWS-FILLET>», «<GWS-FILLET>» or «Fillet» the symbol was born all the same, with the text re-read the same, and WITHOUT the triangle — only the PNG said so.
defect_caught: The symbol with the wrong code (it is born, it is re-read, and it does not draw the triangle), the symbol on an edge that is not a joint, the throat that is not the one asked for.
_the_views_are_called_by_uid: V2, the view from above: the short bar arrives from the side and the line of the joint can be seen.

expect.tolerance_why: 40 mm x 1469.956 mm2 of section, which has pi in it: without the cut the short one stays inside the long one and there is no joint

expect.why: a view attaches to the FILE of the part
the code of the library, the one that draws the triangle
ISO 2553: the throat is written «a» in front of the number, to the left of the symbol
the throat AND the symbol drawn: with a code the library does not know the texts were 1 — the code stayed as text and the triangle was not there
the arrow sits on the line of the joint
one, not zero and not two
